title: E-commerce Platform Redesign
description: A complete fullstack rebuild of a legacy e-commerce platform. Optimized for performance, accessibility, and modern UX patterns.
long_description: Led the frontend architecture migration from jQuery to React, implementing a component-based design system. Integrated real-time inventory management, improved checkout flow by 40%, and reduced bundle size by 60%.

title: Real-time Collaboration Dashboard
description: A WebSocket-powered dashboard for teams to collaborate on projects in real-time, featuring live cursor tracking and instant updates.
long_description: Built with Socket.io and React to enable seamless collaboration across multiple users. Implemented optimistic UI updates, conflict resolution, and a robust state synchronization layer.

title: AI-Powered Content Curator
description: A web application that uses machine learning to aggregate, analyze, and personalize content recommendations for users.
long_description: Integrated OpenAI API for content analysis and used a custom recommendation engine with user preference tracking. Implemented dark mode, accessibility compliance (WCAG AA), and lazy loading for 1000+ articles.
